| Bill Owens | [A lot of people say we're chunks of meat, like cattle, but we're not. We're all individuals with dreams and aspirations like everybody else. | Bill Owens | [I believe in women's liberation. I'm tired of the image of the women who has the most sanitary toilet bowl, the cleanest floor, and the brattiest kids as the supermother., I want to be able to change with my children and to change with my life as I grow older. Staying at home and taking care of the kids doesn't help.](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/133648) | 1972 | Photograph | Photography |  | 53.2010 |

| Bill Owens | [It's a great pleasure to watch yourself make love in the six dozen mirrors that line the ceilings and walls.
